title: Mild Solutions for Path-Dependent Parabolic PDEs with Neumann Boundary Conditions via Generalized BSDEs
summary: We study a system of Forward-Backward Stochastic Differential Equations (FBSDEs) with time-delayed generators. The forward process includes a reflection component expressed via a Stieltjes integral, while the backward process takes the form of a Generalized BSDE. We establish the connection between this FBSDE system and non-linear path-dependent PDEs with Neumann boundary conditions by deriving a representation formula.
